author: Flick Connection
description:
A YouTuber just released his first self-financed horror movie into theaters worldwide. Iron Lung opened to nearly $20 million at the global box office with virtually no marketing spend. That alone makes this movie worth talking about.

In this video, I break down how Markiplier’s Iron Lung movie was made, released, why its opening weekend box office is such a big deal, and how this self-released indie horror film just changed all the rules for indie filmmaking. With almost no traditional marketing, Iron Lung landed on thousands of screens by directly leveraging fan demand, advance ticket sales, and direct theater bookings completely bypassing the current studio system which has kept independent films largely locked out.

I also talk about what Iron Lung actually is, who should see it, and why its claustrophobic sci-fi horror setup reminded me of movies like Buried, Phone Booth, and even Dredd. This isn’t a true blockbuster, but it’s a fascinating example of creator-led filmmaking wher
title: YouTuber Makes First Movie, DESTROYS Hollywood
